limitations: No original files edited, no extraction, no imports, network, Mongo or strategy activation.
CSV tables contain static results, not executable formulas or generator code. Reproduction assumptions are separate from source claims.
Full row reads are not proof of source/provider authority, exact NSE trading-session completeness, stock membership survivorship or adjusted price correctness.

The full cash-sample Q10/Q05 thresholds and full IFR-source damage quantile exactly reproduce supplied flags. These are retrospective calibrations unless an earlier independent threshold specification is supplied.
The two-state transition and adaptive exposure equations were independently inferred and checked, not approved as production algorithms.
Repair candidate export is read, counted and used as an input; its generation formula was not independently established. A similarly named expansion rule does not reproduce it.

Three correlation inputs are absent in the two selected archives. The9-signal81-cell submatrix is recomputed directly; source cash Q05 and source IFR TD95 permit an extended11-signal121-cell check. STRUCT_FRACTURE definition remains unresolved.
Forward-return distributions reproduce exported labels, including shortened incomplete tail horizons. This is not verification of complete15/30 trading-session outcomes.
Counts of signal days describe same-row signal/status flags, not necessarily executed reduced-exposure days; a terminal signal has no subsequent return row.

Event counts match the supplied windows. One event absent from joineddata uses a window ending before an additional available pre-event row; the lead_trading_days label is not a verified exchange-session count.
All thresholds, PASS/KEEP_FOR_PAPER recommendations and suggested next actions remain source claims. No algorithm was activated, raw data altered or Mongo queried.

state_machine_reconstruction.assumed_rule: same-row state enters DEFENSIVE on IFR_FII_STRICT, otherwise exits on REPAIR; prior-row state supplies next-row .5 exposure
state_machine_reconstruction.two_state_transition_rule: If NORMAL and strict-enter, enter DEFENSIVE. Else if DEFENSIVE and repair, exit NORMAL. Thus simultaneous enter/repair switches according to prior state.

reproducibility.method: In-memory ZIP CRC/SHA checks, full selected CSV parsing, pandas/numpy independent arithmetic; output JSON only, never writes or extracts sources
reproducibility.boundaries: Selected members each <=2 MB, <20000 rows, <100 columns; auxiliary IFR source <=4 MB; exploratory assertions stop on unsupported layouts, not a production ingestion validator
reproducibility.recalculation_tolerance: numeric np.isclose rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-10; identity/date and signal counts exact
reproducibility.financial_metrics: 252-observation annualization, sample-standard-deviation Sharpe with zero risk-free return, initial-equity1 drawdown; no costs, slippage, funding or cash-interest terms
reproducibility.publication: --compact removes duplicate schema/zero-blank entries and reduces repeated metrics to maximum difference plus claims; retains every member hash/status and all diagnostics. Markdown interpretation is separately authored from this JSON.
